description: AI-Native Patent Drawing Platform PatentFig AI is a specialized productivity tool designed to streamline the creation of patent-compliant figures. As an AI-native platform, it enables patent professionals to generate high-quality drawings from simple text descriptions or uploaded reference images. The system is engineered to produce outputs that meet the strict standards of major patent offices, including the USPTO, EPO, and CNIPA.
